documents.text: A brass compass marked the northern edge of the map.
Our tomatoes ripened slowly beside the old brick wall.
The train stopped outside a village after midnight.
My cello teacher counted each bar with her pencil.
Pack wool socks for the coastal ferry crossing.

leakageCases.replacement: THE TRAIN STOPPED OUTSIDE A VILLAGE AFTER MIDNIGHT!
The train stopped outside a village after midnight again.
